content: Support service based by-passing for rapid prototyping Type: valid Description: The BSW module description template shall support the description of rapid prototyping service points and associated instances of events, executables and their access to data. In addition implemented enabling flags implementing conditional execution of executables prepared for rapid prototyping needs to be known. Rationale: To support the use of service-based bypass the service points inserted by RTE and the relationship to enabling flags and accessed data needs to be known by the rapid prototyping tooling.
